description: Live AIS position, speed, heading and voyage status (destination, ETA, draught) for one vessel by 9-digit MMSI, from Finland's Digitraffic AIS feed. Covers Finnish and Baltic waters only, not global coverage; vessels outside that area return no position. Choose this tool for: Live AIS position, speed, heading and voyage status for one. Close alternatives on this server: energy_ercot_texas_grid_status (Live Texas grid status from ERCOT's public dashboards); logistics_carnet_ata_status (ATA Carnet country check from the International Chamber). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: logistics_vessel_tracker
